scenario_description: A wrong extracted-license hash invalidates the technical review instead of hiding uncertainty.
expected: The mismatched license file and expected and actual hashes are retained.
The affected package is not counted as validly reviewed.
Unknown metadata returns and the public release gate remains closed.
observed: The deliberate markdown-it-py LICENSE hash mismatch was reported with the exact embedded path.
Valid technical review entries fell to zero and four unresolved unknown-metadata packages returned.
The exact runtime locks still matched, isolating the failure to review integrity rather than package drift.
The public release gate remained closed with three blockers.
notes: PASS means the deliberately corrupt control was rejected. The review fixture and probe SHA make the negative case reproducible.
